title: Top Foldable Phones: Flip vs Fold (2026)
summary: The Galaxy Z Fold 8 is the best foldable for most people, with the Fold 8 Ultra for power users, the Z Flip 8 and Razr for flips, and the Pixel 11 Pro Fold for photos.
method: Picks come from Startech, Mobility Arena, ShopSavvy, Mozillion, PhoneArena, Tom's Guide and Smartprix. Only models named by at least two of these sources are listed.
assumptions: We show no prices because foldable prices change often. Apple unveiled its first foldable, the iPhone Duo, in September 2026, but one source says it had not reached stores yet, so we leave it out until reviews are in.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8
why: Startech and Mobility Arena both name the Galaxy Z Fold 8 the best overall foldable, and ShopSavvy ranks it as the runner-up behind the Ultra. PhoneArena reports demand is so high that Samsung has to build another million units.
Mobility Arena points to Samsung's seven-year update commitment for the Fold 8 and Flip 8.
cons: Smaller battery than the Pixel 11 Pro XL (Smartprix)
products.best_for: Most people who want a book-style foldable
products.skip_if: You want the cheapest foldable or a pocket-sized flip

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra
why: Startech calls the Z Fold 8 Ultra the best premium foldable, Mobility Arena the best big-screen productivity foldable, and ShopSavvy picks it as its overall best.
Smartprix lists an 8-inch inner display, a 5,000mAh battery and a 200MP main camera, against 4,800mAh and 50MP on the standard Fold 8.
pros: Biggest screen and best cameras of any foldable
products.best_for: Power users who want the best foldable money can buy
products.skip_if: You want to save money; the regular Fold 8 covers most needs
products.amazon_listing: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra Unlocked Android Smartphone, 256GB Violet | Customized Proces

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8
why: Startech picks the Galaxy Z Flip 8 as the best flip foldable for everyday use, Mobility Arena as its best flip phone, and ShopSavvy as the budget-friendly way into foldables.
Mozillion calls it the premium end of the flip market.
cons: No productivity benefits of a book-style foldable (Startech)
Tom's Guide says the Flip 8 puts the series in serious doubt
products.best_for: People who want a small, stylish everyday phone that folds
products.skip_if: You want a tablet-sized screen for work
products.amazon_listing: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8 Unlocked Android Smartphone, 256GB Graphite | Hands-Free Selfie Cam

products.name: Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold
why: Startech calls the Pixel 11 Pro Fold the best foldable for photography, Mobility Arena names it the best software experience, and Mozillion says it is the quiet overachiever.
Reviews are mixed: Tom's Guide says it falls behind the foldable curve and Android Police ranks it only fourth best.
cons: Falls short of Samsung's best (Tom's Guide)
products.best_for: Google fans who want a foldable with the best camera software
products.skip_if: You want the strongest hardware and longest support

products.name: Motorola Razr (2026)
why: Mobility Arena names the Motorola Razr 2026 its best-value foldable and the Razr Ultra 2026 its best flip for power and battery, noting the Ultra has the largest battery of the flips it covers at 5,000mAh.
Mozillion also places the Razr at the value end of the flip market.
specs: Razr Ultra has a 5,000mAh battery (Mobility Arena)
pros: Cheapest way into a new foldable
Ultra version has the biggest flip battery
products.best_for: Budget buyers who want a stylish flip phone
products.skip_if: You want the best software support
